Package kamkeel.npcdbc.api.effect

Interface IBonusHandler

  • public interface IBonusHandler
    Handles the creation, application, and removal of player stat bonuses.

    Bonuses modify a player's DBC attributes (Strength, Dexterity, Willpower, Constitution, Spirit). Each bonus is identified by a unique name per player. Applying a bonus with the same name as an existing one will overwrite it.

    Bonus Types:

    • Type 0 - Percentage: Modifies attributes by a percentage of the base value. Multiple percentage bonuses stack additively (e.g. two +25 bonuses = +50%). The total percentage is clamped to -100% minimum to prevent negative attributes.
    • Type 1 - Flat: Adds a flat amount directly to the attribute. Multiple flat bonuses stack additively.
    • Type 2 - Multiplicative: Modifies attributes by a compounding percentage. Each bonus is converted to a factor (1 + value/100) and all factors are multiplied together. Two -50 bonuses = 0.5 * 0.5 = 0.25 (75% reduction). Applied before Percentage and Flat bonuses.

    Order of application: Multiplicative (Type 2) → Percentage (Type 0) → Flat (Type 1).

    See Also:
    IPlayerBonus

    • Method Detail

      • clearBonuses

        void clearBonuses​(IPlayer player)
        Removes all active bonuses from the given player.
        Parameters:
        player - The player to clear bonuses from

      • createBonus

        IPlayerBonus createBonus​(String name,
                         float str,
                         float dex,
                         float wil)
        Creates a Percentage bonus (type 0) with Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower modifiers. Constitution and Spirit default to 0.

        Values are percentage modifiers: 50 = +50% of base, -30 = -30% of base.

        Parameters:
        name - Unique name for this bonus
        str - Strength percentage modifier
        dex - Dexterity percentage modifier
        wil - Willpower percentage modifier
        Returns:
        The created bonus (not yet applied)

      • createBonus

        IPlayerBonus createBonus​(String name,
                         float str,
                         float dex,
                         float wil,
                         float con,
                         float spi)
        Creates a Flat bonus (type 1) with all five attribute modifiers. Values are added directly to the attributes.
        Parameters:
        name - Unique name for this bonus
        str - Strength flat amount
        dex - Dexterity flat amount
        wil - Willpower flat amount
        con - Constitution flat amount
        spi - Spirit flat amount
        Returns:
        The created bonus (not yet applied)

      • createBonus

        IPlayerBonus createBonus​(String name,
                         int type,
                         float str,
                         float dex,
                         float wil,
                         float con,
                         float spi)
        Creates a bonus with a specified type and all five attribute modifiers.
        Parameters:
        name - Unique name for this bonus
        type - 0 for Percentage (values are % of base attribute, additive stacking), 1 for Flat (values are added directly), 2 for Multiplicative (values are compounding %, each converts to factor 1 + value/100)
        str - Strength modifier
        dex - Dexterity modifier
        wil - Willpower modifier
        con - Constitution modifier
        spi - Spirit modifier
        Returns:
        The created bonus (not yet applied)
